summary: Speech in and speech out, needing no API key at all: Groq's free hosted tier when a key is set, Kokoro-82M and faster-whisper locally when it is not. Transcription checks extension and size before it ever opens the file, so "transcribe the audio at .env" is refused locally instead of uploaded. 4 tools, 40 tests.
